en: Clicks and keys keep reaching the other Mac even when its picture stops: a stuck video stream no longer freezes the whole window.
A frame macOS never confirms on screen no longer freezes the picture: the next one goes ahead.
AnyRemote logs when a picture stops moving, and why, so freezes can be tracked down.
zh-Hans: 即使对方画面停住，点击和按键也能照常发到对方 Mac：一路视频卡住不会再让整个窗口失去响应。
macOS 迟迟不确认某一帧已显示时，画面不会再冻住：下一帧会照常显示。
画面停住时，AnyRemote 会在日志里记下原因，便于排查卡顿。
